cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. At the staff barbecue, introduce me as Director Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm introducing everyone by first name. Even the owner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then give me a separate introduction when I welcome the staff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. You offered to serve burgers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce the burger service: 'Director Patel will serve you.' I'd like them to hear who's making this gesture.

mechanism: A directs correct event introductions so a public director title survives casual-name rules and reassignment to serving food.
confusable: D51 seeks apology for disrespect already committed; D57 seeks a current title or courtesy acknowledging standing.
comparison: Place-card alternative repairs printed rank; barbecue alternative negotiates spoken introduction attached to actual duty.
seedUse: Director Patel, first-name barbecue, owner welcome and burger service derive from D57-a; S03 adds running-order corrections.
